findings.title: Token comparison uses non-constant-time equality
findings.claim: Comparing session signatures with === leaks timing information to callers.
findings.failure_scenario: An attacker measures response latency across forged cookies to recover valid MAC bytes.

findings.title: Unchecked null header before split
findings.claim: Existing context line calls header.split(' ') when header can be undefined.
findings.failure_scenario: Missing Authorization header throws TypeError and crashes the request handler.

findings.title: Error message leaks internal state
findings.claim: Returning raw parser details helps callers probe internal routes (see !42).
findings.failure_scenario: Client receives stack hint in 401 body.

findings.title: Redundant string trim
findings.claim: The token is already trimmed upstream.

findings.title: Out-of-diff strong finding falls back to summary
findings.claim: Line 99 is outside the MR diff hunk so it must appear in the collapsed summary block instead of failing inline posting.
findings.failure_scenario: Unbounded map growth over long uptime.
